added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own gate log plus this reviewer's base-arm re-run at the reviewed base: the run names no baseline_suite or after_suite arm pair (its role is implement, so those keys are unarmed), its gate-4586753d.log records 4 passed / 0 failed over the 4-collected test file at the reviewed head's parent, and the reviewer's re-run of the same gate at the base ec1aa7ec also reports 4 passed / 0 failed, so the change adds no failure and its only committed test change extends an existing case.

findings.text: The log's first body line reads "Provide a command or script to invoke with `uv run <command>`" and ~174 lines of uv's command list follow before the pytest session output, because the gate block ran a bare `uv run` pre-warm inside the same redirection it logged; the header's cmd= line does not describe what the log opens with, and a reader scanning the head of the log meets what reads as a failed invocation where the gate actually passed 4 items, so the pre-warm should not sit inside the logged block.

The tests line and test_logs point at the gate recorded at 4586753d, and no log in the run names the reviewed head ffd7c46f; the head commit is docs-only so the result cannot differ, but that is an argument a reader must supply: this reviewer closed it by re-running the named gate at the reviewed head (4 passed, EXIT=0), and one gate line naming the head would make it a recorded fact.
